tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers the forecast horizon, but gradient and initial state vary together and each trajectory contributes only one endpoint. The fine trajectory batch is the relevant probe because the time dependence can distinguish a relaxing memory contribution from a persistent gradient-dependent drive.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The low-gradient rows also have larger initial states, so the pilot cannot tell how much of their higher response comes from weaker inhibition versus transient memory.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a coupled siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoints at similar horizons can constrain net changes without separately identifying the memory relaxation rate, coupling strength, and gradient-dependent drive.
The auxiliary measurement does not resolve the ambiguity between sink inhibition and memory dynamics.
